reviewScope: Covers Fathom Analytics, the hosted SaaS product. Fathom Lite (self-hosted) is documented as a separate variant.
quickAnswer: **Fathom Analytics** (hosted) is the best fit if you want **polished, privacy-first web analytics** with minimal setup and vendor-managed infrastructure. Skip the hosted product if you need free self-hosting — **Fathom Lite** exists for that — or open source; **Plausible** and **Umami** are stronger on those axes.
bestFor: Founders and marketers who want a **clean dashboard** without GA4 learning curve
Growing content and SaaS marketing sites in the **100K–1M pageview** range
Teams that prefer **managed cloud** over operating analytics infrastructure
EU and US sites prioritizing **GDPR-friendly, cookie-light** analytics on the hosted product
notFor: Teams that need **vendor-supported self-hosting** — hosted Fathom Analytics is cloud-only; see **Fathom Lite** if you will ops it yourself
Very small blogs on tight budgets — Plausible's $9/10K tier can be cheaper, or Fathom Lite is free (self-hosted)
Product analytics, session replay, or experimentation — use PostHog or Hotjar

sections.title: Privacy & compliance
sections.content:
Fathom positions itself as **privacy-first**: no cross-site tracking, no sale of visitor data, and analytics designed to reduce cookie-banner friction. Like Plausible, it targets teams that want compliance simplicity without sacrificing usable traffic reports.

**Fathom Analytics** (hosted) runs on Fathom's serverless cloud infrastructure. **Fathom Lite** is a separate self-hosted download you operate yourself — same privacy positioning, but you own uptime, updates, and backups.

Verify consent requirements with legal counsel; "privacy-friendly" does not automatically mean zero compliance obligations in every jurisdiction.

sections.title: Web analytics scope
sections.content:
Hosted **Fathom Analytics** delivers core marketing analytics: **realtime visitors, top pages, referrers, UTMs, goals, custom events**, plus device types, browsers, countries, and email reports per vendor docs.

**Fathom Lite** covers a narrower metric set with fewer ongoing features — Fathom's own comparison notes Lite lacks many hosted-product capabilities and receives no new feature development at the same pace.

Neither product is a full product analytics suite. Fathom answers traffic and conversion questions for **websites**, not in-app telemetry.

sections.title: Hosted vs Fathom Lite
sections.content:
Fathom sells two related products under one brand:

1. **Fathom Analytics** — hosted SaaS from **$15/month**; Fathom handles infrastructure, support, and compliance posture for the managed product.
2. **Fathom Lite** — **free, self-hosted** software you install on your own servers; no vendor support, fewer metrics, and you maintain updates yourself.

Choose hosted Fathom Analytics when you want polish and support. Choose Fathom Lite when you are technical, budget-constrained, and accept self-hosting ops. For open-source self-hosting with an active community edition, Plausible or Umami may still fit better.

sections.title: UX & reliability
sections.content:
Hosted Fathom is frequently praised for **dashboard clarity** and uptime compared with heavier platforms. For teams that abandoned GA4 because nobody looked at reports, Fathom's constraint is a feature.

Tradeoff: less extensibility. Power users who want SQL export, custom dimensions, or warehouse pipelines will outgrow Fathom faster than they outgrow GA4 or Matomo.

Fathom Lite's reliability depends entirely on your hosting — not Fathom's cloud SLA.

setupNotes:
**Typical setup (hosted Fathom Analytics):**

1. Add your site in the Fathom dashboard.
2. Paste the tracking script into your site header (or use a CMS integration).
3. Configure **goals** for conversions you care about.
4. Share the dashboard with teammates as needed.

Expect **15–30 minutes** for hosted setup. **Fathom Lite** requires server provisioning, install, and ongoing maintenance — budget longer if you are new to self-hosting.

**Common pitfalls:** staging domains inflating counts, not tagging campaigns with UTMs, and comparing hosted Fathom numbers directly to GA4 without aligning definitions.
pricingNotes:
**Fathom Analytics** bills on **monthly pageviews** with entry at **$15/month for 100K pageviews** in our directory — higher floor than Plausible's $9/10K tier but more headroom per dollar at moderate traffic. Top published tier is **$169/month at 10M pageviews**.

**Fathom Lite** is **free** (self-hosted); your cost is infrastructure and engineer time. A 7-day trial exists for hosted Fathom Analytics per vendor site.

Our [pricing calculator](/calculators/pricing/) reflects **hosted Fathom Analytics** tiers only, not Lite hosting costs.
limitations: Hosted Fathom Analytics is cloud-only — self-hosting requires the separate Fathom Lite product.
Fathom Lite has fewer metrics, no vendor support, and less feature velocity than hosted Fathom Analytics.
Higher entry price than Plausible Cloud for very small sites on the hosted product.
No session replay, heatmaps, or product analytics on either edition.
Fathom Lite is not open source (vendor distributes binaries; community maintains install docs).
Script performance benchmark pending on AnalyticsVS.

faq.question: Fathom vs Plausible — which is cheaper?
faq.answer: At very low traffic, Plausible's $9/10K tier is usually cheaper than hosted Fathom Analytics. Fathom Lite is free if you self-host. Compare hosted tiers on our pricing calculator.

faq.question: Does Fathom work without cookies?
faq.answer: Hosted Fathom Analytics is designed for privacy-friendly tracking without invasive cross-site cookies. Confirm your implementation and legal obligations with counsel.

faq.question: Can I self-host Fathom?
faq.answer: Yes — via **Fathom Lite**, a separate free self-hosted product. It is not the same as hosted Fathom Analytics: fewer features, no email support, and you manage the server.

faq.question: Fathom Lite vs Fathom Analytics — what's the difference?
faq.answer: Fathom Analytics is hosted SaaS with full metrics, support, and ongoing features. Fathom Lite is a free self-hosted download with a narrower feature set that you install and maintain yourself.
